Sparkonto Haus holds 19'350.30, 97 % of its goal "Rücklage mind. CHF 20'000 (ca. 1.5 % des Hauswerts)".
Instalment plans running: Seeblick Auto-Leasing AG (29 of 48 paid, 9'291.00 left).
9 payments of together 6'566.00 are due in the next 30 days.
On average -246.13 was left per month over the last 6 months; in 2 months more went out than came in (2026-06, 2026-08).

Spending averaged 11'716.70 a month over the last 6 months, highest in 2026-08.
8 payments of together 6'423.30 leave before the salary on 24.12.2026.
The 3 largest monthly payments add up to 2'812.60 a month.
2 savings accounts with their own purpose: Sparkonto Haus (Rücklage für Unterhalt und Nebenkosten des Hauses); Sparkonto Familie (Ferien, Reserve, Ausbildung Kinder).
Simone Baumann sends about 2'600.00 every month, around day 26.
